title: Asabiyyah Substrate Reading
description: One organ's self-measurement of the federation cycle signals. The organ owns its own substrate truth; the kernel only federates. Distilled from Ibn Khaldun's asabiyyah (al-Muqaddimah, 1377) + Usman Awang's Melayu (1992). Observe-only: this reading is evidence, never a verdict.

host.description: Machine that produced this reading (tailscale name or IP).

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 with offset. A reading without a time cannot be acted on.

evidence.description: Raw counts the metrics were derived from. The kernel re-derives the ratios from these, so they must be additive across organs (never pre-divided).

ceremony_artifacts.description: Live doctrine/policy/ritual artifacts (exclude archive, vendored, node_modules).

exercised_capabilities.description: Capabilities with a real invocation receipt inside the observation window.

doctrine_holders.description: Distinct actors that hold/inherit the doctrine or skill.

executors.description: Distinct actors with receipted EXECUTION of the primitive.

gated_paths.description: Protected mutation paths that pass a gate.

total_paths.description: All mutation paths enumerated. 0 = NOT_APPLICABLE, never 1.0 coverage.

ungated.description: Named ungated paths. This is the Kerkoporta list.

window_days.description: Observation window for exercised_capabilities and executors.

source.description: Where the number came from. Empty source = STORY, not MIRROR.
